# The achievements book (Gamecube/menu/AchievementsFrame.cpp) over Spyro's attract demo (scripts/chains/ach_book_bench.txt).
# Hit counts on an always-true condition, so each moment comes a fixed number of evaluated frames after the load
# whatever the game does: #4 unlocks at 100, #3 at 400, #2 is primed from 700 to 1300 hits, then unlocks; #1 and #5
# count (measured: pop-ups at each 10 % step after the settling time); #6 to #12 are never earned in a run.
Game=SCUS94228
Title=Spyro the Dragon
1|Gem Counter|M:0xH000000=0xH000000.2500.|10||Collect 2500 gems in any home world
2|Hold On|0xH000000=0xH000000.700._T:0xH000000=0xH000000.1300.|25|missable|A challenge: primed, then earned
3|Sunny Villa|0xH000000=0xH000000.400.|5|progression|The first world: reach the end of Artisans
4|First Steps|0xH000000=0xH000000.100.|5||Finish the very first level of the game
5|Dragon Hoarder|M:0xH000000=0xH000000.5000.|50||Hold five thousand of anything at once
6|Never One|0xH000001=0xH000001.9999.|5||Not earned in this run
7|The End|0xH000001=0xH000001.9999.|50|win|Beat the game
8|Flameless Run|0xH000001=0xH000001.9999.|25|missable|Defeat every enemy in Artisans without a flame attack and without taking any damage
9|The Extraordinarily Long Titled Achievement of Eternal Doom and Glory|0xH000001=0xH000001.9999.|10||A very long name that has to shrink
10|Speedrunner|0xH000001=0xH000001.9999.|25|progression|Finish a world fast
11|Night Owl|0xH000001=0xH000001.9999.|5||Play after midnight
12|Completionist|0xH000001=0xH000001.9999.|100||All of it
